data.content_ref: inline:The proposed dependence is asserted but not substantiated: the statement that cross-domain temporal correlation 'depends on' SRC_002's substrate monoculture does not articulate any mechanism by which the monoculture produces or controls the correlation — it merely assumes the two endpoints co-occur. 'Refuted if' then substitutes an aliasing condition (BGP update frequency exceeding telemetry sampling rate) that has no linkage to the monoculture claim; the refuting condition could hold even in a diverse substrate, so the dependence relation is left ungrounded.
